items.headline: Flood Warning issued May 5 at 4:34PM AKDT until May 6 at 4:30PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
The ice has stopped at Eagle, water levels are approaching road
level between town and village, flooding may occur if the ice
continues to back up water.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam may occur.

* WHERE...Yukon River near Eagle, Ak.

* WHEN...Until 430 PM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding as well as large blocks of ice being pushed
onshore. Water will remain high until the ice jam releases.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

items.headline: Flood Watch issued May 5 at 4:15PM AKDT until May 6 at 11:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam continues to be possible.

* WHERE...Along the Yukon River, downstream of Dawson

* WHEN...Through Wednesday morning.

* IMPACTS...Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- The Yukon River broke up locally at Eagle on Tuesday morning.
As of 10 am the breakup front had not progressed to Calico
Bluffs. In-place ice shows signs of weakening but the
possibility of minor flooding exists if ice jams form.

items.description:

local breakup front had not yet reached Calico Bluffs.

Canadian border to Coal Creek open and creating small areas of open
water where they entered the Yukon. The ice in the same region was

items.headline: Flood Watch issued May 5 at 12:30PM AKDT until May 6 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam is possible.

* WHERE...From Crooked Creek to below Napaimute.

* WHEN...Through Wednesday evening.

* IMPACTS...Ice jams may result in flooding of rivers, creeks,
streams, sloughs, and other low-lying flood prone locations. Water
may impound behind a jam which may cause flooding several miles
upstream.
